typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

workflowRun.description: Workflow run that this vertex run was created for.

runResult.description: The result for a vertex upon completion.  This may be used by subsequent vertices.

startingActionId.description:
Action ID of the action that executes this vertex.
Developer note: this is set in {@link #setResult} for most vertex types, but it is set in {@link #checkStatus} for Workflow.Run.Conditional.
This field will be set for all vertex types with an associated subtype of {@link Workflow.Run.Vertex} ({@link Workflow.Join} and {@link Workflow.Run.Output} don't fit this description, so they don't have a startingActionId).

inputVertices.description: Input vertices that must be completed to start the vertex

completedVertices.description: Input vertices that have been reported as completed.

requiresPolling.description:
If false, then this vertex's underlying execution takes responsibility for invalidating the {@link WorkflowQueue}
entry corresponding to this {@link workflowRun} (for example, in an "onComplete" callback). In this case,
{@link WorkflowQueue#compute} will not automatically invalidate. In other words, it will not poll this vertex's
status.
NOTE: invalidation needs to happen no matter if the underlying execution is successful or not.
In contrast, if this is true, then the only way to know whether the vertex has finished is to continuously poll it
by re-invalidating {@link WorkflowQueue#compute} for this {@link workflowRun} repeatedly.

executing.description:
Set to true initially in {@link execute} to lock other requests out of concurrently
executing.

completed.description: Set to true when the action for the vertex is successfully completed.

failed.description: Set to true when the action for the vertex fails.

redispatchAttempts.description:
Number of attempts made by {@link #checkStatus} to redispatch the action.
See {@link Workflow.Run.Config#maxActionDispatchAttempts}.

title: A workflow vertex run for a Workflow.Action.
name: Workflow.Run.Action
